records.title: Decline in Ground water Level in Nagpur
details: c to d: Nand and Wadgaon dams (Part of Lower Venna project) located in Nagpur district and Sapan and Upper Wardhan dams located in Amravati district have been included for comprehensive rehabilitation under DRIP.

records.title: MSP INFRASTRUCTURE
details: a: Hence a committee has been constituted by the government to provide MSP to the farmers of the country and to give suggestions on making the system more effective and transparent.
